answer: Since the throttle counters live in the yarrow ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 65 keys as a result forfeits for 65 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the ferrous quota and the terrace admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
